messages:
Elena (devex): FYI running into a weird difference between the JS SDK and the REST API for our search/embedding flow. REST returns 200 + results, SDK throws a 400 on the same payload. :thinking_face:
Samir (sdk): Can you paste the exact requests (curl vs sdk snippet)? often it's a header or small param mismatch.
Elena (devex): Sure — REST curl that works:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-search-v1","query":"refund policy","top_k":5,"filters":{"tenant_id":"acct-123"}}'
```
Elena (devex): JS SDK that fails (minimal):
```js
const {Redwood} = require('@redwood/sdk')
const client = new Redwood(process.env.TOKEN)
await client.search({
  model: 'rwd-search-v1',
  query: 'refund policy',
  top_k: 5,
  filters: { tenant_id: 'acct-123' }
})
```
Elena (devex): Error from SDK: `400 Bad Request — invalid filters` but same body works via curl.
Samir (sdk): Huh. Do you have any middleware or automatic header normalization in your local env? The SDK serializes `filters` differently for older models.
Elena (devex): No middleware. I dumped the outgoing HTTP in node and compared: SDK sends `filters` as `filters: {"tenant_id":"acct-123"}` (stringified JSON) in the body vs REST sends object. Looks like SDK double-stringifies nested objects for this endpoint. :facepalm:
Samir (sdk): That's a bug — we intentionally stringify `metadata` fields for some endpoints but not `filters`. Likely a serializer rule mismatch in v0.9.2. Which SDK version?
Elena (devex): 0.9.2. Workaround: passing `filters: JSON.parse('{"tenant_id":"acct-123"}')` doesn't help. If I pass flat `filter_tenant_id` it works, but that's not acceptable.
Ben (pm): This is worrying — customers using the JS SDK for search could silently get 400s. Any chance retry/fallback behavior differs too?
Samir (sdk): Good question. Also saw a report where SDK's retry logic retries idempotent GETs but not POSTs in some flows because of a `shouldRetry` function that checks `req.method === 'GET'`. For streaming endpoints we intentionally avoid retries, but for non-streaming POSTs we should apply safe retries when the server returns 5xx/429.
QA-Ravi: I can repro with unit test. Repro steps:
1) create client with v0.9.2
2) call search with `filters: { tenant_id: 'acct-123' }`
3) capture body sent to upstream (we'll use nock)
Expected: JSON object for filters. Observed: string.
Samir (sdk): Thanks Ravi. I'll push a quick fix for the serializer. Two follow-ups: 1) add an integration test that compares SDK->HTTP body to curl body; 2) verify retry predicate for POSTs uses safelist instead of exact method equality.
Elena (devex): Another oddity — when I switch to embeddings route, SDK sets `Authorization: Token <val>` header while REST uses `Bearer`. Noticed because our gateway rejects unknown auth schemes. Could be related to an env var fallback.
Samir (sdk): Yikes. We had legacy code that accepted `Token` for internal demos, but prod should be `Bearer`. Which env var did you set?
Elena (devex): Only REDWOOD_API_KEY. No other hacks.
Samir (sdk): Ok two separate bugs then: auth scheme mismatch and filters stringification. I'll open an issue and a patch.
Samir (sdk): created issue #4092 internally — title: "js-sdk: incorrect nested object serialization + auth header scheme regression". Assigning to @samir and @eng-runtime for review.
deploy-bot: New patch branch opened: sdk/fix-serializer-auth-4092 by samir — CI queued.
Ben (pm): Can we prioritize this for the next patch release? This impacts onboarding and our sample app tests.
Samir (sdk): Yep aiming for patch release today if CI is green. Also adding an automated parity test that runs curl vs sdk for the common endpoints (search, embeddings, chat) so this doesn't regress.
QA-Ravi: I'll add a flaky test that asserts identical JSON bodies for the three endpoints, and a smoke test that ensures auth header is `Bearer`.
Elena (devex): Thanks — also flagging the sample-apps repo. The quickstart search example uses the JS SDK and broke a new user yesterday (support ticket). I'll send a PR to pin sample-apps to SDK v0.9.3 once patch releases.
Ben (pm): Good. Action items: Samir to land patch, Ravi to add tests, Elena to update docs/sample-apps, Ben to notify support and update changelog.
Samir (sdk): I'll post the patch link when CI passes.
Elena (devex): :thumbsup: closing loop once sample-apps is updated.
QA-Ravi: Leaving a note in the onboarding tracker: "JS SDK v0.9.2 had filters/auth regressions — pinned to v0.9.3+"
Samir (sdk): Patch merged, release v0.9.3 published. changelog: "fix: nested object serialization for search/embeddings; fix: auth header scheme; add parity tests"
Elena (devex): Confirmed sample-apps quickstart works with v0.9.3. All good on my side.
Ben (pm): Thanks team.
